4957.context: Leaving superstition isn't just about dropping beliefs, it's about letting go of the fear that kept you small, fear of disappointing a deity, fear of eternal punishment, fear of asking the wrong questions, fear of being too much or not enough. Once you shed that fear, you open the door to something powerful, the freedom to grow in the direction of your deepest truth. This is the shift from obedience to ownership. In the world of superstition, growth is often reduced to obedience.

claims.text: The term 'truth' functions as a standard against which established beliefs, such as those found in religious texts or prophecies, are measured for validity (L1, L2, L3, L11). It also serves to define the scope of inquiry, suggesting that critical evaluation is necessary for all claims, including political policies (L9).
